content.short: Otterscan is an open-source Ethereum block explorer.
content.description: Otterscan, created in 2021 by William Mitsuda, is an Ethereum blockchain explorer built on Erigon. It can be run locally on a laptop with an archive node companion, specifically Erigon. Developers can use Otterscan’s custom methods, implemented at the RPC daemon level, for faster access.
